evidence.interpretation: Program is unattributed and sampling is diagnostic. Neither the2LoAF records nor component samples establish an exclusive bottleneck or predict a sub100ms result.

existingOptimizations: SessionController already caches presentation alignment by accepted sequence and target.
OpponentPaceMarker already reuses measured correct-prefix geometry and returns previous point state when coordinates do not change.
TypingPassage already memoizes passage blocks and character chunks, and idle snapshots retain aligned character arrays.

proposals.change: Publish own/bot state only when exact visible progress, bot cursor or rendered integer WPM changes. Keep null distinct from zero. Both Track and race legend currently render integer WPM; canonical controller metrics, elapsed time and final results remain raw and unchanged.
mustPreserve: First accepted character origin and shared human clock
proposals.risk: Small UI-only semantic adapter change; verify visible output equivalence and matched latency, not guaranteed by static reasoning.

proposals.change: Memoize opponentPace by its fields and optionally wrap TypingArea in standard React.memo. Do not use a comparator that ignores genuine prop changes. Its own state/context must continue updating.
proposals.limits: This cannot skip a genuine own-input render or a changed opponent position. It may remove parent-only idle work; actual impact requires a benchmark.

proposals.change: When a rival exists, memoize canonical target grapheme count by snapshot.targetText instead of allocating characters.filter(expected!==null) on every render. Avoid a new parse for non-rival/free modes.
mustPreserve: Use canonical graphemes rather than UTF16 length
Extra/missed slots do not change target-unit count
proposals.risk: Exact count-equivalence must be checked on Unicode/prose/code/extra-character scenarios.

validation: Preserve original112ms failure and instrumented profile separately.
Run existing race pace, first-character timing, wrong-key/correction and keyboard tests.
Confirm raw/exported metrics and actual rival positions are unchanged.
